```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Setup
# ==============================
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

# Core libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(lubridate)
  library(knitr)

# Ensure survminer functions are available
if (!exists("ggsurvplot")) {
  if (requireNamespace("survminer", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ggsurvplot <- survminer::ggsurvplot
  } else {
    stop("survminer package is required for Kaplan-Meier plots")
  }
}

# excel_sheets is already available from readxl package

# Helper function: Robust date parser
as_date_safe <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
  out <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(v))
  # Excel serials (roughly 1955–2064)
  is_serial <- !is.na(num) & num > 20000 & num < 60000
  out[is_serial] <- as.Date(num[is_serial], origin = "1899-12-30")
  # Strings
  left <- !is_serial
  if (any(left)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(v[left], orders = c("Y-m-d","m/d/Y","d/m/Y","m/d/y","d/m/y","Ymd"), tz = "UTC"))
    out[left] <- as.Date(parsed)
  }
  # Clamp to reasonable range
  bad <- is.na(out) | year(out) < 2000 | year(out) > 2100
  out[bad] <- as.Date(NA)
  out
}

# Build long ctDNA data from wide columns
build_ctdna_long <- function(dat, id_col) {
  val <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp", values_to = "ctdna_value_raw") %>%
    mutate(ctdna_value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", gsub(",", "", as.character(ctdna_value_raw))))) )
  dt  <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col), matches("^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col), names_to = "tp_date", values_to = "ctdna_date_raw")
  out <- val %>%
    mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp, "\\d+"))) %>%
    left_join(dt %>% mutate(tp_idx = as.integer(str_extract(tp_date, "\\d+"))) %>% select(all_of(id_col), tp_idx, ctdna_date_raw),
              by = c(id_col, "tp_idx")) %>%
    mutate(ctdna_date = as_date_safe(ctdna_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_date), !is.na(ctdna_value)) %>%
    select(all_of(id_col), ctdna_date, ctdna_value) %>%
    arrange(.data[[id_col]], ctdna_date)
  out
}
```

```{r load_and_combine_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Load and Combine Both Datasets
# ==============================

cat("=== Loading Lower Tract Dataset ===\n")
# Lower tract dataset
file_path_lower <- "Natera_Sheet_Master1.xlsx"
# Check available sheets and use the correct one
available_sheets_lower <- excel_sheets(file_path_lower)
cat("Available sheets in lower tract file:", paste(available_sheets_lower, collapse = ", "), "\n")
sheet_name_lower <- if ("Master_Sheet" %in% available_sheets_lower) {
  "Master_Sheet"
} else if ("Sheet1" %in% available_sheets_lower) {
  "Sheet1"
} else {
  available_sheets_lower[1]  # Use first sheet
}
cat("Using sheet:", sheet_name_lower, "\n")
raw_lower <- read_excel(file_path_lower, sheet = sheet_name_lower, col_names = FALSE)
var_names_lower <- raw_lower[[1]]
dat_lower <- as.data.frame(t(raw_lower[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(dat_lower) <- make.unique(var_names_lower, sep = "_")
dat_lower <- clean_names(dat_lower)

# Identify patient ID column
id_col_lower <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat_lower)) {
  "record_id_linking_key"
} else {
  id_candidates <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(id_candidates) > 0) id_candidates[1] else names(dat_lower)[2]
}

# Filter blank IDs
dat_lower <- dat_lower %>%
  mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_lower]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_check), str_trim(id_check) != "", str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
  select(-id_check)

# Add dataset identifier
dat_lower$dataset <- "Lower Tract"

cat("Lower tract patients:", nrow(dat_lower), "\n")

cat("\n=== Loading Upper Tract Dataset ===\n")
# Upper tract dataset
file_path_upper <- "Natera_Sheet_UTUC.xlsx"
raw_upper <- read_excel(file_path_upper, sheet = "Sheet1", col_names = FALSE)
var_names_upper <- raw_upper[[1]]
dat_upper <- as.data.frame(t(raw_upper[, -1]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(dat_upper) <- make.unique(var_names_upper, sep = "_")
dat_upper <- clean_names(dat_upper)

# Identify patient ID column
id_col_upper <- if ("record_id_linking_key" %in% names(dat_upper)) {
  "record_id_linking_key"
} else {
  id_candidates <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("record.*id|id.*linking|linking.*key", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(id_candidates) > 0) id_candidates[1] else names(dat_upper)[2]
}

# Filter blank IDs
dat_upper <- dat_upper %>%
  mutate(id_check = as.character(.data[[id_col_upper]])) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_check), str_trim(id_check) != "", str_trim(id_check) != "NA") %>%
  select(-id_check)

# Add dataset identifier
dat_upper$dataset <- "Upper Tract"

cat("Upper tract patients:", nrow(dat_upper), "\n")

# Standardize ID column name for both datasets
dat_lower <- dat_lower %>% rename(patient_id = all_of(id_col_lower))
dat_upper <- dat_upper %>% rename(patient_id = all_of(id_col_upper))

# Convert date columns
date_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
date_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

dat_lower <- dat_lower %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols_lower), as_date_safe))
dat_upper <- dat_upper %>% mutate(across(all_of(date_cols_upper), as_date_safe))

# Normalize ctDNA column names
names(dat_lower) <- str_replace_all(names(dat_lower), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")
names(dat_upper) <- str_replace_all(names(dat_upper), regex("^ct[_ ]?dna[_ ]?level(\\d+)$", ignore_case = TRUE), "ct_dna_level_\\1")

# Ensure ctDNA numeric columns are numeric
ctdna_value_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(ctdna_value_cols_lower)) {
  dat_lower[ctdna_value_cols_lower] <- lapply(dat_lower[ctdna_value_cols_lower], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
    y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

ctdna_value_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("^ct_dna_level_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(ctdna_value_cols_upper)) {
  dat_upper[ctdna_value_cols_upper] <- lapply(dat_upper[ctdna_value_cols_upper], function(x) {
    y <- gsub(",", "", as.character(x))
    y <- gsub("^<\\s*", "", y)
    y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", "Not detected", "Undetected", "NEGATIVE", "Negative", "neg", "ND")] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
  })
}

cat("\n=== Combining Datasets ===\n")
# Find common columns for combining
common_cols <- intersect(names(dat_lower), names(dat_upper))
cat("Common columns:", length(common_cols), "\n")

# Combine datasets (keeping only common columns)
dat_combined <- bind_rows(
  dat_lower %>% select(all_of(common_cols), dataset),
  dat_upper %>% select(all_of(common_cols), dataset)
)

cat("Total combined patients:", nrow(dat_combined), "\n")
cat("  - Lower tract:", sum(dat_combined$dataset == "Lower Tract"), "\n")
cat("  - Upper tract:", sum(dat_combined$dataset == "Upper Tract"), "\n")

# Extract cancer stage information
# Look for stage columns (T stage, pathology stage, clinical stage, etc.)
stage_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("stage|t_stage|pathology.*stage|clinical.*stage|cancer.*stage", ignore_case = TRUE))]

cat("\nStage-related columns found:", paste(stage_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Function to extract numeric stage from stage string
extract_stage_number <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || x == "" || x == "NA") return(NA_real_)
  x_upper <- toupper(as.character(x))
  # Look for T2, T3, T4, Stage II, Stage III, Stage IV, etc.
  if (str_detect(x_upper, "T[234]|STAGE\\s*[I]{2,}|STAGE\\s*[IVX]+")) {
    # Extract T stage number
    t_match <- str_extract(x_upper, "T([234])")
    if (!is.na(t_match)) {
      return(as.numeric(str_extract(t_match, "\\d+")))
    }
    # Extract stage number (II, III, IV)
    stage_match <- str_extract(x_upper, "STAGE\\s*([IVX]+)")
    if (!is.na(stage_match)) {
      stage_roman <- str_extract(stage_match, "[IVX]+")
      stage_map <- c("I" = 1, "II" = 2, "III" = 3, "IV" = 4)
      if (stage_roman %in% names(stage_map)) {
        return(stage_map[stage_roman])
      }
    }
  }
  # Check for T1 or Stage I (these are stage I, not II+)
  if (str_detect(x_upper, "T1|STAGE\\s*I[^IVX]")) {
    return(1)
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}

# Extract stage for each patient
if (length(stage_cols) > 0) {
  patient_stage <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, all_of(stage_cols)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Try to extract stage from each column
      stage_values = {
        values <- c_across(all_of(stage_cols))
        stages <- map_dbl(values, extract_stage_number)
        max(stages, na.rm = TRUE)  # Take highest stage if multiple
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      stage_numeric = ifelse(is.infinite(stage_values), NA_real_, stage_values),
      stage_ii_or_higher = !is.na(stage_numeric) & stage_numeric >= 2
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset, stage_numeric, stage_ii_or_higher)
} else {
  # If no stage columns found, assume all patients are Stage II+ (or create a warning)
  cat("WARNING: No stage columns found. Including all patients.\n")
  patient_stage <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
    mutate(
      stage_numeric = NA_real_,
      stage_ii_or_higher = TRUE  # Include all if we can't determine stage
    )
}

cat("\nStage distribution:\n")
print(table(patient_stage$stage_numeric, useNA = "always"))
cat("\nPatients with Stage II or higher:", sum(patient_stage$stage_ii_or_higher, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Patients with Stage I or unknown:", sum(!patient_stage$stage_ii_or_higher | is.na(patient_stage$stage_ii_or_higher), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Filter to only Stage II or higher
dat_combined <- dat_combined %>%
  left_join(patient_stage %>% select(patient_id, stage_ii_or_higher), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(stage_ii_or_higher == TRUE)

cat("\nAfter filtering to Stage II or higher:", nrow(dat_combined), "patients\n")
```

```{r build_ctdna_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Build Combined ctDNA Data
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Building ctDNA Data ===\n")

# Build long ctDNA data for combined dataset
ctdna_long <- build_ctdna_long(dat_combined, "patient_id")

cat("Total ctDNA measurements:", nrow(ctdna_long), "\n")
cat("Patients with ctDNA data:", length(unique(ctdna_long$patient_id)), "\n")

# Add dataset identifier
ctdna_long <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(dat_combined %>% select(patient_id, dataset), by = "patient_id")

# Calculate baseline ctDNA (first measurement per patient)
baseline_ctdna <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(ctdna_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, baseline_date = ctdna_date, baseline_value = ctdna_value, dataset)

cat("\nPatients with baseline ctDNA:", nrow(baseline_ctdna), "\n")
cat("  Baseline positive (ctDNA > 0):", sum(baseline_ctdna$baseline_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Baseline negative (ctDNA = 0):", sum(baseline_ctdna$baseline_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r calculate_lbrecist, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Calculate LB-RECIST Response Categories
# REMOVED: Not needed for current analysis
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Calculating LB-RECIST Response Categories ===\n")

# LB-RECIST Criteria:
# 1. Complete Response (CR): ctDNA becomes negative (0) from a positive baseline, confirmed
# 2. Partial Response (PR): ≥50% reduction in ctDNA from baseline (and not CR)
# 3. Stable Disease (SD): Neither CR/PR nor PD criteria met
# 4. Progressive Disease (PD): ≥50% increase in ctDNA from baseline, or new positive ctDNA after being negative

# For each patient, calculate best response
# Join baseline data (dataset is already in ctdna_long, but we need baseline info)
response_data <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date, baseline_value), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  # Calculate change from baseline
  mutate(
    days_from_baseline = as.numeric(ctdna_date - baseline_date),
    percent_change = case_when(
      baseline_value == 0 ~ NA_real_,  # Can't calculate % change from 0
      baseline_value > 0 ~ ((ctdna_value - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    absolute_change = ctdna_value - baseline_value,
    # Status indicators
    became_negative = (baseline_value > 0 & ctdna_value == 0),
    became_positive = (baseline_value == 0 & ctdna_value > 0),
    reduction_50pct = (baseline_value > 0 & percent_change <= -50),
    increase_50pct = (baseline_value > 0 & percent_change >= 50)
  ) %>%
  # Only consider measurements after baseline
  filter(days_from_baseline > 0) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date)

# Calculate best response per patient
# Verify dataset column exists
if (!"dataset" %in% names(response_data)) {
  # Add dataset from baseline_ctdna if missing
  response_data <- response_data %>%
    left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, dataset), by = "patient_id")
}

best_response <- response_data %>%
  group_by(patient_id, dataset) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
    baseline_date = first(baseline_date),
    n_measurements = n(),
    # Check for CR: became negative and stayed negative (or at least one negative after positive baseline)
    has_cr = any(became_negative, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Check for PR: ≥50% reduction (but not CR)
    has_pr = any(reduction_50pct, na.rm = TRUE) & !any(became_negative, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Check for PD: ≥50% increase OR became positive from negative baseline
    has_pd = any(increase_50pct, na.rm = TRUE) | any(became_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Best percent reduction
    best_reduction = min(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Worst increase
    worst_increase = max(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Last measurement
    last_value = last(ctdna_value),
    last_date = last(ctdna_date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Assign response category
    lbrecist_response = case_when(
      has_cr ~ "Complete Response (CR)",
      has_pr ~ "Partial Response (PR)",
      has_pd ~ "Progressive Disease (PD)",
      TRUE ~ "Stable Disease (SD)"
    ),
    # Additional details
    response_detail = case_when(
      has_cr ~ paste0("CR: ctDNA became negative (baseline: ", round(baseline_value, 2), ")"),
      has_pr ~ paste0("PR: ≥50% reduction (best: ", round(best_reduction, 1), "%)"),
      has_pd ~ paste0("PD: ≥50% increase or new positive (worst: ", round(worst_increase, 1), "%)"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("SD: No significant change (change: ", round(ifelse(!is.na(best_reduction), best_reduction, 0), 1), "%)")
    )
  )

cat("\nLB-RECIST Response Categories:\n")
print(table(best_response$lbrecist_response))

cat("\nBy Dataset:\n")
print(table(best_response$dataset, best_response$lbrecist_response))
```

```{r response_summary_tables, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Response Summary Tables
# REMOVED: LB-RECIST section not needed
# ==============================

cat("\n=== LB-RECIST Response Summary ===\n\n")

# Overall summary table
summary_table <- best_response %>%
  count(lbrecist_response) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
    `N (%)` = paste0(n, " (", Percent, "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(Response = lbrecist_response, `N (%)`, n) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

kable(summary_table, caption = "Overall LB-RECIST Response Distribution") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

cat("\n\n")

# By dataset
summary_by_dataset <- best_response %>%
  count(dataset, lbrecist_response) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
    `N (%)` = paste0(n, " (", Percent, "%)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Dataset = dataset, Response = lbrecist_response, `N (%)`, n) %>%
  arrange(Dataset, desc(n))

kable(summary_by_dataset, caption = "LB-RECIST Response by Dataset") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

cat("\n\n")

# Detailed patient-level table (sample)
detailed_table <- best_response %>%
  select(patient_id, dataset, baseline_value, n_measurements, lbrecist_response, response_detail) %>%
  arrange(dataset, lbrecist_response, patient_id) %>%
  head(20)

kable(detailed_table, caption = "Sample of Patient-Level LB-RECIST Responses (First 20)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE)
```

```{r response_visualizations, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Response Visualizations
# REMOVED: LB-RECIST section not needed
# ==============================

# 1. Bar chart of response categories
p1 <- best_response %>%
  count(lbrecist_response) %>%
  mutate(
    lbrecist_response = factor(lbrecist_response, 
                               levels = c("Complete Response (CR)", "Partial Response (PR)", 
                                          "Stable Disease (SD)", "Progressive Disease (PD)"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lbrecist_response, y = n, fill = lbrecist_response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Complete Response (CR)" = "#2E7D32",
                               "Partial Response (PR)" = "#66BB6A",
                               "Stable Disease (SD)" = "#FFA726",
                               "Progressive Disease (PD)" = "#E53935")) +
  labs(title = "LB-RECIST Response Distribution",
       x = "Response Category",
       y = "Number of Patients",
       fill = "Response") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 2. Response by dataset
p2 <- best_response %>%
  count(dataset, lbrecist_response) %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    lbrecist_response = factor(lbrecist_response, 
                               levels = c("Complete Response (CR)", "Partial Response (PR)", 
                                          "Stable Disease (SD)", "Progressive Disease (PD)"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = dataset, y = pct, fill = lbrecist_response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Complete Response (CR)" = "#2E7D32",
                               "Partial Response (PR)" = "#66BB6A",
                               "Stable Disease (SD)" = "#FFA726",
                               "Progressive Disease (PD)" = "#E53935"),
                    name = "Response") +
  labs(title = "LB-RECIST Response by Dataset",
       x = "Dataset",
       y = "Percentage of Patients (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# 3. Baseline ctDNA distribution by response
p3 <- best_response %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    lbrecist_response = factor(lbrecist_response, 
                               levels = c("Complete Response (CR)", "Partial Response (PR)", 
                                          "Stable Disease (SD)", "Progressive Disease (PD)"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lbrecist_response, y = baseline_value, fill = lbrecist_response)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Complete Response (CR)" = "#2E7D32",
                               "Partial Response (PR)" = "#66BB6A",
                               "Stable Disease (SD)" = "#FFA726",
                               "Progressive Disease (PD)" = "#E53935"),
                    guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Baseline ctDNA by Response Category",
       x = "Response Category",
       y = "Baseline ctDNA (log scale)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Combine plots
combined_plots <- (p1 | p2) / p3
combined_plots <- combined_plots + 
  plot_annotation(title = "LB-RECIST Response Evaluation",
                  subtitle = "Liquid Biopsy Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors")

print(combined_plots)
```

```{r export_results, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Export Results
# REMOVED: LB-RECIST section not needed
# ==============================

# Create comprehensive results table
results_export <- best_response %>%
  left_join(
    ctdna_long %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(
        first_ctdna_date = min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        total_measurements = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    dataset,
    baseline_date,
    baseline_value,
    first_ctdna_date,
    last_ctdna_date,
    total_measurements,
    n_measurements,
    lbrecist_response,
    response_detail,
    best_reduction,
    worst_increase,
    last_value
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset, lbrecist_response, patient_id)

# Write to CSV
write.csv(results_export, "LB_RECIST_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Results Exported ===\n")
cat("Results saved to: LB_RECIST_Results.csv\n")
cat("Total patients with LB-RECIST assessment:", nrow(results_export), "\n")
```

```{r extract_survival_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Extract Survival and Relapse Data
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Extracting Survival and Relapse Data ===\n")

# Extract relapse/progression dates from combined dataset
relapse_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
relapse_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Extract survival/death dates
survival_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("death.*date|died.*date|survival.*date|last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("death.*date|died.*date|survival.*date|last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Extract death status
death_status_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("death|died|vital.*status|alive|dead", ignore_case = TRUE))]
death_status_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("death|died|vital.*status|alive|dead", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Function to extract survival data from a dataset
extract_survival_data <- function(dat, id_col_name, raw_data = NULL, row_num = NULL) {
  # Get relapse date
  relapse_date <- NULL
  relapse_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("metastatic.*relapse.*date|relapse.*date|metastasis.*date|progression.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(relapse_cols) > 0) {
    relapse_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(relapse_date_raw = all_of(relapse_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(relapse_date = as_date_safe(relapse_date_raw)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), relapse_date)
    relapse_date <- relapse_data
  }
  
  # Get explicit death date (separate from follow-up date)
  explicit_death_date <- NULL
  death_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                 !str_detect(names(dat), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
    death_date_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(death_date_raw = all_of(death_date_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        # Check if already a Date object, otherwise convert
        explicit_death_date = if (inherits(death_date_raw, "Date")) {
          death_date_raw
        } else {
          as_date_safe(death_date_raw)
        }
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), explicit_death_date)
    explicit_death_date <- death_date_data
  }
  
  # Get survival/follow-up date (last follow-up date)
  survival_date <- NULL
  survival_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                              !str_detect(names(dat), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
    survival_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(survival_date_raw = all_of(survival_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(survival_date = as_date_safe(survival_date_raw)) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), survival_date)
    survival_date <- survival_data
  }
  
  # Get alive yes/no status (row 259 in raw Excel)
  alive_status <- NULL
  alive_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
    alive_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(alive_status_raw = all_of(alive_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        alive_yes_no = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(alive_status_raw)), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), alive_yes_no)
    alive_status <- alive_data
  }
  
  # Get death status (legacy - for backward compatibility)
  death_status <- NULL
  death_status_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("death|died|vital.*status", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                   !str_detect(names(dat), regex("date|alive", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(death_status_cols) > 0) {
    death_data <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
      rename(death_status_raw = all_of(death_status_cols[1])) %>%
      mutate(
        death_status_legacy = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(as.character(death_status_raw)), "yes|dead|died|death|deceased") ~ 1,
          TRUE ~ 0
        )
      ) %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), death_status_legacy)
    death_status <- death_data
  }
  
  # Extract palliative therapy start dates (these indicate relapse/progression)
  palliative_dates <- NULL
  # Look for systemic therapy columns with palliative setting
  therapy_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  therapy_start_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
    # Get all therapy settings and start dates
    therapy_settings_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "setting") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
        setting_lower = tolower(as.character(setting))
      ) %>%
      filter(str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative"))
    
    therapy_starts_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_idx = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"),
        start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date))
    
    # Join to get palliative therapy start dates
    palliative_dates <- therapy_settings_long %>%
      left_join(therapy_starts_long, by = c(id_col_name, "therapy_idx")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
      summarise(
        first_palliative_date = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      rename(palliative_start_date = first_palliative_date)
  }
  
  # Combine
  result <- dat %>% select(all_of(id_col_name))
  if (!is.null(relapse_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(relapse_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(relapse_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(explicit_death_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(explicit_death_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(explicit_death_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(survival_date)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(survival_date, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(survival_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  if (!is.null(alive_status)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(alive_status, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(alive_yes_no = NA_character_)
  }
  if (!is.null(death_status)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(death_status, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(death_status_legacy = NA_real_)
  }
  if (!is.null(palliative_dates)) {
    result <- result %>% left_join(palliative_dates, by = id_col_name)
  } else {
    result <- result %>% mutate(palliative_start_date = as.Date(NA))
  }
  
  result
}

# Extract survival data from both datasets
# Pass raw data for row-based extraction if needed
survival_lower <- extract_survival_data(dat_lower, "patient_id", raw_lower, row_num = 259)
survival_lower$dataset <- "Lower Tract"

survival_upper <- extract_survival_data(dat_upper, "patient_id", raw_upper, row_num = 259)
survival_upper$dataset <- "Upper Tract"

# Combine survival data
survival_data <- bind_rows(survival_lower, survival_upper)

cat("Survival data extracted for", nrow(survival_data), "patients\n")
cat("  Patients with relapse date:", sum(!is.na(survival_data$relapse_date)), "\n")
cat("  Patients with survival date:", sum(!is.na(survival_data$survival_date)), "\n")
cat("  Patients with explicit death date:", sum(!is.na(survival_data$explicit_death_date)), "\n")
cat("  Patients with alive_yes_no == 'No':", sum(survival_data$alive_yes_no == "No", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Patients with death_status_legacy == 1:", sum(survival_data$death_status_legacy == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r create_survival_outcomes, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Create Survival Outcomes
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Creating Survival Outcomes ===\n")

# Merge survival data with baseline ctDNA and response data
# Start from ALL patients in combined dataset, not just those with baseline ctDNA
all_patients <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, dataset) %>%
  distinct()

# Get last ctDNA date for each patient (for censoring if no follow-up date)
last_ctdna_dates <- ctdna_long %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    last_ctdna_date = max(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get last systemic therapy date for each patient (for censoring if no follow-up date)
# Extract all systemic therapy dates (start and end)
therapy_date_cols_lower <- names(dat_lower)[str_detect(names(dat_lower), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*(start|end).*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
therapy_date_cols_upper <- names(dat_upper)[str_detect(names(dat_upper), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*(start|end).*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Function to extract last therapy date
extract_last_therapy_date <- function(dat, id_col_name) {
  therapy_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*(start|end).*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if (length(therapy_cols) > 0) {
    therapy_dates_long <- dat %>%
      select(all_of(id_col_name), all_of(therapy_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-all_of(id_col_name), names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "therapy_date_raw") %>%
      mutate(therapy_date = as_date_safe(therapy_date_raw)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_date)) %>%
      group_by(.data[[id_col_name]]) %>%
      summarise(
        last_therapy_date = max(therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    return(therapy_dates_long)
  } else {
    return(tibble(!!id_col_name := dat[[id_col_name]], last_therapy_date = as.Date(NA)))
  }
}

last_therapy_lower <- extract_last_therapy_date(dat_lower, "patient_id")
last_therapy_upper <- extract_last_therapy_date(dat_upper, "patient_id")
last_therapy_dates <- bind_rows(last_therapy_lower, last_therapy_upper) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    last_therapy_date = max(last_therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(last_therapy_date = ifelse(is.infinite(last_therapy_date), as.Date(NA), last_therapy_date))

# Create survival outcomes for ALL patients (already filtered to Stage II+)
survival_outcomes <- all_patients %>%
  # Add baseline ctDNA data (if available)
  left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
  # Add last ctDNA date
  left_join(last_ctdna_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
  # Add last systemic therapy date
  left_join(last_therapy_dates, by = "patient_id") %>%
  # Add survival data
  left_join(survival_data, by = "patient_id") %>%
  # Add response data (if available) - LB-RECIST removed
  # left_join(best_response %>% select(patient_id, lbrecist_response, n_measurements), by = "patient_id") %>%
  # Use baseline date as time 0 for survival analysis (or first ctDNA date, or follow-up start)
  mutate(
    # Time anchor: Use first ctDNA measurement (baseline_date) as time 0 for OS
    # If no baseline_date, try to use first ctDNA date or follow-up date as anchor
    time_anchor = coalesce(baseline_date, survival_date),
    # Combine relapse dates: use explicit relapse_date OR palliative_start_date (whichever is earlier)
    relapse_date_combined = case_when(
      !is.na(relapse_date) & !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ pmin(relapse_date, palliative_start_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      !is.na(relapse_date) ~ relapse_date,
      !is.na(palliative_start_date) ~ palliative_start_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    # Determine death status and date:
    # 1. If explicit_death_date exists, patient is dead at that date
    # 2. If alive_yes_no == "No", patient is dead at last available follow-up
    # 3. Otherwise, assume alive
    death_status_final = case_when(
      !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ 1,  # Has explicit death date
      alive_yes_no == "No" ~ 1,  # Marked as not alive
      !is.na(death_status_legacy) & death_status_legacy == 1 ~ 1,  # Legacy death status
      TRUE ~ 0  # Assume alive
    ),
    # Death date: use explicit death date, or last follow-up if alive_yes_no == "No"
    death_date = case_when(
      !is.na(explicit_death_date) ~ explicit_death_date,  # Use explicit death date
      alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,  # Use last follow-up if marked as not alive
      alive_yes_no == "No" & !is.na(relapse_date_combined) ~ relapse_date_combined,  # Fallback to relapse date
      death_status_legacy == 1 & !is.na(survival_date) ~ survival_date,  # Legacy: use follow-up
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate max of ctDNA and therapy dates (using rowwise to handle Date objects properly)
    max_ctdna_therapy_date = {
      if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date) && !is.na(last_therapy_date)) {
        as.Date(max(as.numeric(last_ctdna_date), as.numeric(last_therapy_date)), origin = "1970-01-01")
      } else if (!is.na(last_ctdna_date)) {
        last_ctdna_date
      } else if (!is.na(last_therapy_date)) {
        last_therapy_date
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      }
    },
    # Last available date: prefer follow-up, then max of ctDNA/therapy
    last_available_date = {
      if (!is.na(survival_date)) {
        survival_date
      } else if (!is.na(max_ctdna_therapy_date)) {
        max_ctdna_therapy_date
      } else {
        as.Date(NA)
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Time to event (in months from first ctDNA measurement)
    time_to_relapse = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                            as.numeric(relapse_date_combined - time_anchor) / 30.44,
                            NA_real_),
    time_to_death = ifelse(!is.na(death_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                          as.numeric(death_date - time_anchor) / 30.44,
                          NA_real_),
    # Time to last follow-up or last available date (for censoring alive patients)
    time_to_last_fu = ifelse(!is.na(last_available_date) & !is.na(time_anchor),
                             as.numeric(last_available_date - time_anchor) / 30.44,
                             NA_real_),
    # Event indicators
    # Relapse: explicit relapse date OR starting palliative therapy
    relapse_event = ifelse(!is.na(relapse_date_combined), 1, 0),
    # Death event: use death_status_final (includes explicit death date, alive_yes_no == "No", etc.)
    death_event = death_status_final,
    # PFS time: time to relapse OR time to last follow-up (censored)
    pfs_time = ifelse(relapse_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_relapse), time_to_relapse, 
                     ifelse(!is.na(time_to_last_fu), time_to_last_fu, NA_real_)),
    # OS time: time from first ctDNA measurement to death OR last follow-up (censored for alive patients)
    os_time = ifelse(
      death_event == 1 & !is.na(time_to_death), 
      time_to_death,  # Dead: use time to death
      ifelse(
        !is.na(time_to_last_fu), 
        time_to_last_fu,  # Alive: use time to last follow-up (censored)
        NA_real_
      )
    )
  )
  # Patients already filtered to Stage II or higher

cat("Total patients included:", nrow(survival_outcomes), "\n")
cat("  Patients with baseline ctDNA:", sum(!is.na(survival_outcomes$baseline_value)), "\n")
cat("  Patients with follow-up data:", sum(!is.na(survival_outcomes$time_to_last_fu)), "\n")
cat("  PFS events:", sum(survival_outcomes$relapse_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  OS events:", sum(survival_outcomes$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Patients with explicit death date:", sum(!is.na(survival_outcomes$explicit_death_date)), "\n")
cat("  Patients marked as dead (alive_yes_no == 'No'):", sum(survival_outcomes$alive_yes_no == "No", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Total patients marked as dead:", sum(survival_outcomes$death_status_final == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Patients assumed alive:", sum(survival_outcomes$death_status_final == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

```{r approach1_qualitative_criteria, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Approach 1: Qualitative Criteria (from PDF Table 1)
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Approach 1: Qualitative Criteria ===\n")
cat("Based on PDF Table 1 - Qualitative ctDNA Response Categories\n")

# Qualitative criteria typically based on ctDNA positive/negative status
# Common categories:
# 1. ctDNA Clearance: Positive → Negative
# 2. ctDNA Persistent Negative: Always negative
# 3. ctDNA Persistent Positive: Always positive  
# 4. ctDNA Conversion: Negative → Positive

# Include all patients, even those without ctDNA data
qualitative_groups <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(
    ctdna_long %>%
      left_join(baseline_ctdna, by = "patient_id") %>%
      filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_status = ifelse(first(baseline_value) > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    ever_negative = any(ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    ever_positive = any(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_status = ifelse(last(ctdna_value) > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    qualitative_group = case_when(
      baseline_status == "Positive" & last_status == "Negative" ~ "ctDNA Clearance",
      baseline_status == "Negative" & last_status == "Negative" ~ "Persistent Negative",
      baseline_status == "Positive" & last_status == "Positive" ~ "Persistent Positive",
      baseline_status == "Negative" & last_status == "Positive" ~ "ctDNA Conversion",
      TRUE ~ "No ctDNA Data"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, qualitative_group, baseline_status, last_status),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  # Fill in missing values for patients without ctDNA data
  mutate(
    qualitative_group = ifelse(is.na(qualitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", qualitative_group)
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, qualitative_group, baseline_status, last_status)

cat("\nQualitative Groups Distribution:\n")
print(table(qualitative_groups$qualitative_group))

# Merge with survival outcomes (include all patients)
survival_qualitative <- survival_outcomes %>%
  left_join(qualitative_groups, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(qualitative_group = ifelse(is.na(qualitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", qualitative_group))

cat("\nPatients with qualitative grouping and survival data:", nrow(survival_qualitative), "\n")
```

```{r approach2_quantitative_criteria, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Approach 2: Quantitative Criteria (from PDF Table 1)
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Approach 2: Quantitative Criteria ===\n")
cat("Based on PDF Table 1 - Quantitative ctDNA Response Categories\n")

# Quantitative criteria typically based on percent change thresholds
# Common categories:
# 1. Major Response: ≥90% reduction
# 2. Partial Response: ≥50% reduction (but <90%)
# 3. Stable: <50% change (increase or decrease)
# 4. Progressive: ≥50% increase

# Build response_data for quantitative criteria (similar to LB-RECIST but just for percent change)
response_data_quant <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_date, baseline_value), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  # Calculate change from baseline
  mutate(
    days_from_baseline = as.numeric(ctdna_date - baseline_date),
    percent_change = case_when(
      baseline_value == 0 ~ NA_real_,  # Can't calculate % change from 0
      baseline_value > 0 ~ ((ctdna_value - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    absolute_change = ctdna_value - baseline_value
  ) %>%
  # Only consider measurements after baseline
  filter(days_from_baseline > 0) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date)

# Verify dataset column exists
if (!"dataset" %in% names(response_data_quant)) {
  response_data_quant <- response_data_quant %>%
    left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, dataset), by = "patient_id")
}

# Include all patients in quantitative groups
quantitative_groups <- all_patients %>%
  left_join(
    response_data_quant %>%
      group_by(patient_id, dataset) %>%
      summarise(
        baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
        best_reduction_pct = min(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
        worst_increase_pct = max(percent_change, na.rm = TRUE),
        max_value = max(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
        min_value = min(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        quantitative_group = case_when(
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(best_reduction_pct) & best_reduction_pct <= -90 ~ "Major Response (≥90% reduction)",
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(best_reduction_pct) & best_reduction_pct <= -50 & best_reduction_pct > -90 ~ "Partial Response (≥50% reduction)",
          baseline_value > 0 & !is.na(worst_increase_pct) & worst_increase_pct >= 50 ~ "Progressive (≥50% increase)",
          baseline_value > 0 ~ "Stable (<50% change)",
          baseline_value == 0 & max_value > 0 ~ "New Positive",
          baseline_value == 0 & max_value == 0 ~ "Persistent Negative",
          TRUE ~ "No ctDNA Data"
        )
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, quantitative_group, best_reduction_pct, worst_increase_pct),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(quantitative_group = ifelse(is.na(quantitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", quantitative_group))

cat("\nQuantitative Groups Distribution:\n")
print(table(quantitative_groups$quantitative_group))

# Merge with survival outcomes (include all patients)
survival_quantitative <- survival_outcomes %>%
  left_join(quantitative_groups, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(quantitative_group = ifelse(is.na(quantitative_group), "No ctDNA Data", quantitative_group))

cat("\nPatients with quantitative grouping and survival data:", nrow(survival_quantitative), "\n")
```

```{r approach3_machine_learning, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Approach 3: Machine Learning to Generate Subgroups
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Approach 3: Machine Learning Approach ===\n")
cat("Generating distinct subgroups based on ctDNA patterns using ML\n")
cat("Using train/validation/test split for proper model evaluation\n")

# Prepare features for ML
# First calculate trend separately
# Include all patients, but only calculate features for those with ctDNA data
ctdna_with_trend <- ctdna_long %>%
  left_join(baseline_ctdna %>% select(patient_id, baseline_value, baseline_date), by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_value)) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, ctdna_date) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    time_from_first = as.numeric(ctdna_date - min(ctdna_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
    row_num = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate trend for each patient using a helper function
calculate_trend <- function(values, times) {
  valid <- !is.na(values) & !is.na(times)
  if (sum(valid) > 1) {
    tryCatch({
      lm_fit <- lm(values[valid] ~ times[valid])
      as.numeric(coef(lm_fit)[2])
    }, error = function(e) 0)
  } else {
    0
  }
}

trend_data <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, sum(!is.na(ctdna_value)) > 1, sum(!is.na(time_from_first)) > 1) %>%
  summarise(
    trend = calculate_trend(ctdna_value, time_from_first),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Patients without trend (single measurement or insufficient data)
patients_no_trend <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n == 1 | !patient_id %in% trend_data$patient_id) %>%
  mutate(trend = 0) %>%
  select(patient_id, trend)

trend_all <- bind_rows(trend_data, patients_no_trend)

# Now create ML features - enhanced for better stratification
ml_features <- ctdna_with_trend %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(
    baseline_value = first(baseline_value),
    n_measurements = n(),
    mean_ctdna = mean(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_ctdna = median(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_ctdna = max(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ctdna = min(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ctdna = sd(ctdna_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Status changes
    n_positive = sum(ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_negative = sum(ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    became_negative = any(baseline_value > 0 & ctdna_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    became_positive = any(baseline_value == 0 & ctdna_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Additional features for better stratification
    last_value = last(ctdna_value),
    first_value = first(ctdna_value),
    # Percent change from baseline to last
    pct_change_baseline = ifelse(baseline_value > 0, 
                                 ((last(ctdna_value) - baseline_value) / baseline_value) * 100,
                                 ifelse(baseline_value == 0 & last(ctdna_value) > 0, 100, 0)),
    # Time span of measurements
    time_span_days = as.numeric(max(ctdna_date) - min(ctdna_date)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(trend_all, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # Variability
    cv_ctdna = ifelse(mean_ctdna > 0 & !is.na(sd_ctdna), sd_ctdna / mean_ctdna, 0),
    # Normalized trend (per day)
    trend_per_day = ifelse(!is.na(time_span_days) & time_span_days > 0, trend / time_span_days, 0),
    # Response pattern indicators
    clearance_pattern = became_negative & baseline_value > 0,
    conversion_pattern = became_positive & baseline_value == 0,
    persistent_positive = baseline_value > 0 & !became_negative & last_value > 0,
    persistent_negative = baseline_value == 0 & !became_positive & last_value == 0,
    # Handle missing values
    across(c(mean_ctdna, median_ctdna, max_ctdna, min_ctdna, sd_ctdna, trend, cv_ctdna, 
             trend_per_day, pct_change_baseline, time_span_days),
           ~ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))
  )

# Split data into train/validation/test sets (60/20/20)
set.seed(123)
n_patients_ml <- nrow(ml_features)
train_idx <- sample(n_patients_ml, size = floor(0.6 * n_patients_ml))
remaining_idx <- setdiff(1:n_patients_ml, train_idx)
validation_idx <- sample(remaining_idx, size = floor(0.5 * length(remaining_idx)))
test_idx <- setdiff(remaining_idx, validation_idx)

ml_features_train <- ml_features[train_idx, ]
ml_features_validation <- ml_features[validation_idx, ]
ml_features_test <- ml_features[test_idx, ]

cat("Data split:\n")
cat("  Training set:", length(train_idx), "patients (", round(100 * length(train_idx) / n_patients_ml, 1), "%)\n")
cat("  Validation set:", length(validation_idx), "patients (", round(100 * length(validation_idx) / n_patients_ml, 1), "%)\n")
cat("  Test set:", length(test_idx), "patients (", round(100 * length(test_idx) / n_patients_ml, 1), "%)\n")

# Select features for clustering - focus on clinically relevant features
# Exclude patient_id, baseline_value (we'll use it for interpretation)
feature_cols <- setdiff(names(ml_features), c("patient_id", "baseline_value"))

# Prepare training data
ml_features_train_for_clustering <- ml_features_train %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols))

# Remove any infinite or NaN values before scaling
ml_features_train_for_clustering <- ml_features_train_for_clustering %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

# Scale features using training data statistics
ml_features_train_scaled <- scale(ml_features_train_for_clustering)
ml_features_train_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_train_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_train_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_train_scaled)] <- 0

# Store scaling parameters for validation/test sets
scale_center <- attr(ml_features_train_scaled, "scaled:center")
scale_scale <- attr(ml_features_train_scaled, "scaled:scale")

# Determine optimal number of clusters (using training data)
n_train <- nrow(ml_features_train_scaled)
if (n_train >= 6) {
  # Try 4-6 clusters and use elbow method
  wss <- numeric(6)
  for (k in 2:6) {
    if (k < n_train) {
      km <- kmeans(ml_features_train_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 10, iter.max = 100)
      wss[k] <- km$tot.withinss
    }
  }
  # Use 5 clusters for better stratification
  n_clusters <- 5
  cat("Using", n_clusters, "clusters for ML subgrouping\n")
} else if (n_train >= 4) {
  n_clusters <- 4
  cat("Using", n_clusters, "clusters for ML subgrouping\n")
} else {
  n_clusters <- max(2, n_train)
  cat("WARNING: Limited training data. Using", n_clusters, "clusters.\n")
}

# Fit k-means on training data
kmeans_result_train <- kmeans(ml_features_train_scaled, centers = n_clusters, nstart = 50, iter.max = 200)
cluster_centers <- kmeans_result_train$centers

cat("K-means fitted on training set with", n_clusters, "clusters\n")

# Function to assign patients to nearest cluster center
assign_to_cluster <- function(features_scaled, centers) {
  # Calculate distances to each cluster center
  distances <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(features_scaled), ncol = nrow(centers))
  for (i in 1:nrow(features_scaled)) {
    for (j in 1:nrow(centers)) {
      distances[i, j] <- sum((features_scaled[i, ] - centers[j, ])^2)
    }
  }
  # Assign to nearest center
  apply(distances, 1, which.min)
}

# Scale validation and test sets using training set statistics
ml_features_validation_for_clustering <- ml_features_validation %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

ml_features_test_for_clustering <- ml_features_test %>%
  select(all_of(feature_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~{
    x <- .
    x[is.infinite(x)] <- 0
    x[is.nan(x)] <- 0
    x
  }))

# Scale using training set parameters
ml_features_validation_scaled <- scale(ml_features_validation_for_clustering, 
                                        center = scale_center, 
                                        scale = scale_scale)
ml_features_test_scaled <- scale(ml_features_test_for_clustering, 
                                 center = scale_center, 
                                 scale = scale_scale)

ml_features_validation_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_validation_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_validation_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_validation_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_test_scaled[is.infinite(ml_features_test_scaled)] <- 0
ml_features_test_scaled[is.nan(ml_features_test_scaled)] <- 0

# Assign validation and test sets to clusters
validation_clusters <- assign_to_cluster(ml_features_validation_scaled, cluster_centers)
test_clusters <- assign_to_cluster(ml_features_test_scaled, cluster_centers)

# Combine all assignments
ml_features_all <- ml_features %>%
  mutate(
    dataset_split = case_when(
      patient_id %in% ml_features_train$patient_id ~ "Train",
      patient_id %in% ml_features_validation$patient_id ~ "Validation",
      patient_id %in% ml_features_test$patient_id ~ "Test",
      TRUE ~ "Not in ML analysis"
    ),
    ml_cluster = case_when(
      patient_id %in% ml_features_train$patient_id ~ kmeans_result_train$cluster[match(patient_id, ml_features_train$patient_id)],
      patient_id %in% ml_features_validation$patient_id ~ validation_clusters[match(patient_id, ml_features_validation$patient_id)],
      patient_id %in% ml_features_test$patient_id ~ test_clusters[match(patient_id, ml_features_test$patient_id)],
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )

cat("Cluster assignments:\n")
cat("  Training set clusters assigned\n")
cat("  Validation set assigned to nearest cluster centers\n")
cat("  Test set assigned to nearest cluster centers\n")

# Store cluster centers and scaling parameters for clinical use
ml_model_parameters <- list(
  cluster_centers = cluster_centers,
  scale_center = scale_center,
  scale_scale = scale_scale,
  feature_cols = feature_cols,
  n_clusters = n_clusters
)

cat("\n=== ML Model Parameters Saved for Clinical Use ===\n")
cat("Cluster centers and scaling parameters have been saved.\n")
cat("These can be used to classify new patients.\n")

# Characterize each cluster using training data only (for interpretation)
cluster_characteristics <- ml_features_train %>%
  mutate(ml_cluster = kmeans_result_train$cluster) %>%
  group_by(ml_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_baseline = mean(baseline_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_baseline = median(baseline_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_max = mean(max_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_trend = mean(trend, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pct_change = mean(pct_change_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_clearance = mean(clearance_pattern, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_conversion = mean(conversion_pattern, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_persistent_pos = mean(persistent_positive, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_persistent_neg = mean(persistent_negative, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    mean_cv = mean(cv_ctdna, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_baseline, mean_trend)

# Assign descriptive names based on comprehensive characteristics
# Strategy: Create clinically meaningful groups based on ctDNA dynamics
cluster_names <- cluster_characteristics %>%
  mutate(
    group_name = case_when(
      # Group 1: Clearance/Response - started positive, became negative
      pct_clearance >= 50 & mean_trend < 0 ~ "Clearance/Response (Positive→Negative)",
      
      # Group 2: Conversion/Progression - started negative, became positive
      pct_conversion >= 50 & mean_trend > 0 ~ "Conversion/Progression (Negative→Positive)",
      
      # Group 3: Persistent High - always positive, high baseline, increasing or stable high
      mean_baseline > 5 & pct_persistent_pos >= 50 & mean_trend >= 0 ~ "Persistent High ctDNA (Stable/Increasing)",
      
      # Group 4: Persistent Low/Negative - always negative or very low
      mean_baseline <= 1 & pct_persistent_neg >= 50 ~ "Persistent Low/Negative ctDNA",
      
      # Group 5: Variable/Unstable - high variability, mixed patterns
      mean_cv > 1.0 | (pct_clearance < 50 & pct_conversion < 50 & pct_persistent_pos < 50 & pct_persistent_neg < 50) ~ "Variable/Unstable ctDNA Pattern",
      
      # Group 6: Decreasing but not cleared - positive baseline, decreasing but not to zero
      mean_baseline > 0 & mean_trend < 0 & pct_clearance < 50 ~ "Decreasing ctDNA (Not Cleared)",
      
      # Default fallback
      TRUE ~ paste0("Group ", ml_cluster, ": Mixed Pattern")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(ml_cluster, group_name)

cat("\n=== ML Subgroup Development Methodology ===\n")
cat("Features used for clustering:\n")
cat("  1. Baseline ctDNA value\n")
cat("  2. Number of measurements\n")
cat("  3. Mean, median, max, min ctDNA values\n")
cat("  4. Standard deviation and coefficient of variation\n")
cat("  5. Trend (linear regression slope of ctDNA over time)\n")
cat("  6. Trend per day (normalized trend)\n")
cat("  7. Percent change from baseline to last measurement\n")
cat("  8. Time span of measurements\n")
cat("  9. Status changes (became negative/positive)\n")
cat("  10. Response patterns (clearance, conversion, persistent)\n")
cat("\nClustering method: K-means with 4-6 clusters (depending on data)\n")
cat("Scaling: All features standardized before clustering\n")
cat("Group assignment: Based on cluster characteristics and clinical patterns\n\n")

# Create ml_groups with cluster assignments for all patients
ml_groups <- ml_features_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(ml_cluster)) %>%
  left_join(cluster_names, by = "ml_cluster") %>%
  select(patient_id, ml_group = group_name, dataset_split, ml_cluster)

cat("\nML-Generated Groups Distribution:\n")
print(table(ml_groups$ml_group))

cat("\nCluster Characteristics:\n")
print(cluster_characteristics)

# Merge with survival outcomes (include all patients)
survival_ml <- survival_outcomes %>%
  left_join(ml_groups %>% select(patient_id, ml_group), by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(ml_group = ifelse(is.na(ml_group), "No ctDNA Data", ml_group))

cat("\nPatients with ML grouping and survival data:", nrow(survival_ml), "\n")

# Get total patient count for abstract
total_patients_abstract <- nrow(survival_outcomes)
cat("\nTotal patients included in analysis:", total_patients_abstract, "\n")

# Save ML model parameters for clinical use
if (exists("ml_model_parameters")) {
  # Create a comprehensive model specification document
  ml_model_spec <- list(
    model_type = "K-means Clustering",
    n_clusters = ml_model_parameters$n_clusters,
    features_used = ml_model_parameters$feature_cols,
    cluster_centers = as.data.frame(ml_model_parameters$cluster_centers),
    scaling_center = ml_model_parameters$scale_center,
    scaling_scale = ml_model_parameters$scale_scale,
    cluster_names = cluster_names
  )
  
  # Save to RDS for potential future use
  saveRDS(ml_model_spec, "ML_Model_Specification.rds")
  cat("\nML model specification saved to: ML_Model_Specification.rds\n")
}
```

```{r kaplan_meier_curves}
# ==============================
# Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Generating Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves ===\n")

# Function to create survival object and plot
create_km_plot <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var, title, ylab = "Survival Probability", 
                          show_legend = TRUE, reference_group = NULL) {
  # Filter to valid data and exclude "No ctDNA Data" groups
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0) {
    cat("No valid data for", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check if we have events
  if (sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    cat("No events for", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Add temporary columns with standard names for formula
  data_plot <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(
      surv_time = .data[[time_var]],
      surv_event = .data[[event_var]],
      surv_group = .data[[group_var]]
    )
  
  # Identify reference group (usually persistent negative)
  if (is.null(reference_group)) {
    # Try to find persistent negative group
    groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
    ref_candidates <- groups[str_detect(tolower(groups), "persistent.*negative|negative.*persistent")]
    if (length(ref_candidates) > 0) {
      reference_group <- ref_candidates[1]
    } else {
      # Use first group alphabetically as reference
      reference_group <- sort(groups)[1]
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate pairwise log-rank tests comparing each group to reference
  all_groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
  groups <- all_groups[all_groups != reference_group & !is.na(all_groups)]
  
  # Use a list to store p-values instead of named vector
  pairwise_pvals_list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    # Subset data to reference and current group
    data_subset <- data_plot %>%
      filter(surv_group %in% c(reference_group, groups[i]))
    
    if (nrow(data_subset) > 0 && sum(data_subset$surv_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      surv_formula_subset <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
      logrank_test <- tryCatch({
        survdiff(surv_formula_subset, data = data_subset)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(logrank_test)) {
        p_val <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
        pairwise_pvals_list[[groups[i]]] <- p_val
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Format p-values with asterisks
  format_pval <- function(p) {
    if (length(p) == 0 || is.na(p) || p >= 0.05) return("")
    if (p < 0.001) return("***")
    if (p < 0.01) return("**")
    if (p < 0.05) return("*")
    return("")
  }
  
  # Create survival formula and fit first
  surv_formula <- as.formula("Surv(surv_time, surv_event) ~ surv_group")
  fit <- do.call("survfit", list(formula = surv_formula, data = quote(data_plot)))
  
  # Create labels with p-values - need to match order of groups in fit object
  # Get the order from the survival fit object
  fit_groups <- names(fit$strata)
  if (is.null(fit_groups) || length(fit_groups) == 0) {
    fit_groups <- unique(data_plot$surv_group)
  } else {
    # Extract group names from strata names (format: "surv_group=GroupName")
    fit_groups <- sub("^surv_group=", "", fit_groups)
  }
  
  # Ensure fit_groups is a simple character vector without names
  fit_groups <- as.character(fit_groups)
  fit_groups <- fit_groups[!is.na(fit_groups)]
  
  group_labels_with_pval <- character(length(fit_groups))
  names(group_labels_with_pval) <- NULL  # Ensure no names
  
  for (i in seq_along(fit_groups)) {
    if (fit_groups[i] == reference_group) {
      group_labels_with_pval[i] <- fit_groups[i]
    } else {
      # Access p-value from list
      p_val <- pairwise_pvals_list[[fit_groups[i]]]
      if (length(p_val) == 1 && !is.na(p_val) && p_val > 0) {
        group_labels_with_pval[i] <- paste0(fit_groups[i], format_pval(p_val))
      } else {
        group_labels_with_pval[i] <- fit_groups[i]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Ensure no names on the labels vector
  names(group_labels_with_pval) <- NULL
  
  # Get number of groups
  n_groups <- length(unique(data_plot$surv_group))
  
  # Use simple sequential color scheme (previous approach)
  colors <- c("#2E7D32", "#66BB6A", "#FFA726", "#E53935", "#9C27B0", "#00BCD4", "#795548", "#607D8B")[1:n_groups]
  
  # Abbreviate y-axis labels
  ylab_abbrev <- ifelse(ylab == "Progression-Free Survival", "PFS", 
                       ifelse(ylab == "Overall Survival", "OS", ylab))
  
  # Ensure labels are clean (no names)
  group_labels_final <- as.character(group_labels_with_pval)
  names(group_labels_final) <- NULL
  
  # Create plot using survminer
  p <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
    fit,
    data = data_plot,
    pval = TRUE,
    pval.size = 4,
    conf.int = FALSE,
    risk.table = TRUE,
    risk.table.height = 0.25,
    risk.table.fontsize = 3.5,
    risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
    risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
    ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
    title = title,
    xlab = "Time (months)",
    ylab = ylab_abbrev,
    legend = "right",  # Always show legend to see p-values
    legend.title = "",
    legend.labs = group_labels_final,
    palette = colors,
    font.main = 12,
    font.x = 10,
    font.y = 10,
    font.tickslab = 9
  )
  
  # Remove "surv_group=" from legend if it appears
  if (!is.null(p$plot)) {
    p$plot <- p$plot + 
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Create all plots first, then arrange in grid
p1_pfs <- NULL
p1_os <- NULL
p2_pfs <- NULL
p2_os <- NULL
p3_pfs <- NULL
p3_os <- NULL

# Approach 1: Qualitative Criteria - PFS (with legend)
if (exists("survival_qualitative") && nrow(survival_qualitative) > 0 && sum(survival_qualitative$relapse_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  p1_pfs <- create_km_plot(
    survival_qualitative,
    "pfs_time",
    "relapse_event",
    "qualitative_group",
    "Qualitative: PFS",
    "Progression-Free Survival",
    show_legend = TRUE,
    reference_group = "Persistent Negative"
  )
}

# Approach 1: Qualitative Criteria - OS (with legend to show p-values)
if (exists("survival_qualitative") && nrow(survival_qualitative) > 0 && sum(survival_qualitative$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  p1_os <- create_km_plot(
    survival_qualitative,
    "os_time",
    "death_event",
    "qualitative_group",
    "Qualitative: OS",
    "Overall Survival",
    show_legend = TRUE,  # Show legend to see p-values
    reference_group = "Persistent Negative"
  )
}

# Approach 2: Quantitative Criteria - PFS (with legend)
if (exists("survival_quantitative") && nrow(survival_quantitative) > 0 && sum(survival_quantitative$relapse_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  p2_pfs <- create_km_plot(
    survival_quantitative,
    "pfs_time",
    "relapse_event",
    "quantitative_group",
    "Quantitative: PFS",
    "Progression-Free Survival",
    show_legend = TRUE,
    reference_group = "Persistent Negative"
  )
}

# Approach 2: Quantitative Criteria - OS (with legend to show p-values)
if (exists("survival_quantitative") && nrow(survival_quantitative) > 0 && sum(survival_quantitative$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  p2_os <- create_km_plot(
    survival_quantitative,
    "os_time",
    "death_event",
    "quantitative_group",
    "Quantitative: OS",
    "Overall Survival",
    show_legend = TRUE,  # Show legend to see p-values
    reference_group = "Persistent Negative"
  )
}

# Approach 3: Machine Learning - PFS (with legend)
if (exists("survival_ml") && nrow(survival_ml) > 0 && sum(survival_ml$relapse_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  p3_pfs <- create_km_plot(
    survival_ml,
    "pfs_time",
    "relapse_event",
    "ml_group",
    "ML: PFS",
    "Progression-Free Survival",
    show_legend = TRUE,
    reference_group = "Persistent Low/Negative ctDNA"
  )
}

# Approach 3: Machine Learning - OS (with legend to show p-values)
if (exists("survival_ml") && nrow(survival_ml) > 0 && sum(survival_ml$death_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  p3_os <- create_km_plot(
    survival_ml,
    "os_time",
    "death_event",
    "ml_group",
    "ML: OS",
    "Overall Survival",
    show_legend = TRUE,  # Show legend to see p-values
    reference_group = "Persistent Low/Negative ctDNA"
  )
}

# Arrange plots in grid: PFS on left, OS on right, each row is a method
# Extract the plot objects from ggsurvplot (they return lists with $plot)
plots_list <- list()
if (!is.null(p1_pfs) && !is.null(p1_pfs$plot)) plots_list[["Qual_PFS"]] <- p1_pfs$plot
if (!is.null(p1_os) && !is.null(p1_os$plot)) plots_list[["Qual_OS"]] <- p1_os$plot
if (!is.null(p2_pfs) && !is.null(p2_pfs$plot)) plots_list[["Quant_PFS"]] <- p2_pfs$plot
if (!is.null(p2_os) && !is.null(p2_os$plot)) plots_list[["Quant_OS"]] <- p2_os$plot
if (!is.null(p3_pfs) && !is.null(p3_pfs$plot)) plots_list[["ML_PFS"]] <- p3_pfs$plot
if (!is.null(p3_os) && !is.null(p3_os$plot)) plots_list[["ML_OS"]] <- p3_os$plot

# Create grid layout: 3 rows (methods) x 2 columns (PFS, OS)
if (length(plots_list) >= 2) {
  # Build grid row by row
  row1 <- NULL
  row2 <- NULL
  row3 <- NULL
  
  if (!is.null(plots_list[["Qual_PFS"]]) && !is.null(plots_list[["Qual_OS"]])) {
    row1 <- plots_list[["Qual_PFS"]] | plots_list[["Qual_OS"]]
  } else if (!is.null(plots_list[["Qual_PFS"]])) {
    row1 <- plots_list[["Qual_PFS"]]
  } else if (!is.null(plots_list[["Qual_OS"]])) {
    row1 <- plots_list[["Qual_OS"]]
  }
  
  if (!is.null(plots_list[["Quant_PFS"]]) && !is.null(plots_list[["Quant_OS"]])) {
    row2 <- plots_list[["Quant_PFS"]] | plots_list[["Quant_OS"]]
  } else if (!is.null(plots_list[["Quant_PFS"]])) {
    row2 <- plots_list[["Quant_PFS"]]
  } else if (!is.null(plots_list[["Quant_OS"]])) {
    row2 <- plots_list[["Quant_OS"]]
  }
  
  if (!is.null(plots_list[["ML_PFS"]]) && !is.null(plots_list[["ML_OS"]])) {
    row3 <- plots_list[["ML_PFS"]] | plots_list[["ML_OS"]]
  } else if (!is.null(plots_list[["ML_PFS"]])) {
    row3 <- plots_list[["ML_PFS"]]
  } else if (!is.null(plots_list[["ML_OS"]])) {
    row3 <- plots_list[["ML_OS"]]
  }
  
  # Combine rows
  combined_grid <- NULL
  if (!is.null(row1) && !is.null(row2) && !is.null(row3)) {
    combined_grid <- row1 / row2 / row3
  } else if (!is.null(row1) && !is.null(row2)) {
    combined_grid <- row1 / row2
  } else if (!is.null(row1) && !is.null(row3)) {
    combined_grid <- row1 / row3
  } else if (!is.null(row2) && !is.null(row3)) {
    combined_grid <- row2 / row3
  } else if (!is.null(row1)) {
    combined_grid <- row1
  } else if (!is.null(row2)) {
    combined_grid <- row2
  } else if (!is.null(row3)) {
    combined_grid <- row3
  }
  
  if (!is.null(combined_grid)) {
    # Add footnote about p-value reference
    combined_grid <- combined_grid + 
      plot_annotation(
        title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves by ctDNA Response Criteria",
        subtitle = "PFS (left) and OS (right) for Qualitative, Quantitative, and ML-based approaches",
        caption = "P-value asterisks (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001) indicate pairwise log-rank test comparing each group to the reference group (Persistent Negative/Low ctDNA). Reference group has no asterisks."
      ) &
      theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0, face = "italic"))
    print(combined_grid)
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data to create combined survival plots\n")
  }
} else {
  # Fallback: print individual plots if grid not possible
  if (!is.null(p1_pfs)) print(p1_pfs)
  if (!is.null(p1_os)) print(p1_os)
  if (!is.null(p2_pfs)) print(p2_pfs)
  if (!is.null(p2_os)) print(p2_os)
  if (!is.null(p3_pfs)) print(p3_pfs)
  if (!is.null(p3_os)) print(p3_os)
}
```

```{r model_comparison, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Model Comparison: Qualitative vs Quantitative vs ML
# ==============================

cat("\n=== Model Performance Comparison ===\n")

# Function to calculate Harrell's C-index (concordance)
calculate_c_index <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, n = 0, cox_fit = NULL))
  }
  
  # Fit Cox model
  surv_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  cox_fit <- tryCatch({
    coxph(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit)) {
    return(list(c_index = NA_real_, n = nrow(data_clean), cox_fit = NULL))
  }
  
  # Calculate C-index (concordance)
  c_index <- tryCatch({
    summary(cox_fit)$concordance[1]
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  aic_value <- tryCatch({
    AIC(cox_fit)
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  
  return(list(c_index = c_index, n = nrow(data_clean), aic = aic_value, cox_fit = cox_fit))
}

# Function to compare C-indices between two models using bootstrap
compare_c_indices <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var1, group_var2, n_bootstrap = 1000) {
  # Get common patients with valid data for both models
  data_clean1 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var1]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var1]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  data_clean2 <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var2]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var2]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  # Get common patients
  common_patients <- intersect(data_clean1$patient_id, data_clean2$patient_id)
  
  if (length(common_patients) < 10) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, n_common = length(common_patients)))
  }
  
  data_common <- data %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% common_patients) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0,
           !is.na(.data[[group_var1]]), !is.na(.data[[group_var2]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var1]]), "no ctdna data"),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var2]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_common) == 0 || sum(data_common[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, n_common = 0))
  }
  
  # Calculate C-indices on full data
  surv_formula1 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var1))
  surv_formula2 <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var2))
  
  cox_fit1 <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data_common), error = function(e) NULL)
  cox_fit2 <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data_common), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (is.null(cox_fit1) || is.null(cox_fit2)) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, n_common = nrow(data_common)))
  }
  
  c_index1 <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit1)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  c_index2 <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit2)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  if (is.na(c_index1) || is.na(c_index2)) {
    return(list(p_value = NA_real_, diff_c_index = NA_real_, n_common = nrow(data_common)))
  }
  
  diff_observed <- c_index1 - c_index2
  
  # Bootstrap to get p-value
  set.seed(123)
  n <- nrow(data_common)
  diff_bootstrap <- numeric(n_bootstrap)
  
  for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
    boot_idx <- sample(1:n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    data_boot <- data_common[boot_idx, ]
    
    cox_fit1_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula1, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    cox_fit2_boot <- tryCatch(coxph(surv_formula2, data = data_boot), error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_fit1_boot) && !is.null(cox_fit2_boot)) {
      c1_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit1_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      c2_boot <- tryCatch(summary(cox_fit2_boot)$concordance[1], error = function(e) NA_real_)
      
      if (!is.na(c1_boot) && !is.na(c2_boot)) {
        diff_bootstrap[i] <- c1_boot - c2_boot
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Calculate p-value (two-sided test)
  # P-value is proportion of bootstrap differences as extreme or more extreme than observed
  p_value <- mean(abs(diff_bootstrap) >= abs(diff_observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  return(list(
    p_value = p_value,
    diff_c_index = diff_observed,
    c_index1 = c_index1,
    c_index2 = c_index2,
    n_common = nrow(data_common),
    n_bootstrap = sum(!is.na(diff_bootstrap))
  ))
}

# Function to calculate log-rank test p-value
calculate_logrank_pvalue <- function(data, time_var, event_var, group_var) {
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]), 
           .data[[time_var]] > 0, !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
           !str_detect(tolower(.data[[group_var]]), "no ctdna data"))
  
  if (nrow(data_clean) == 0 || sum(data_clean[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  surv_formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  surv_fit <- survfit(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  
  # Log-rank test
  logrank_test <- tryCatch({
    survdiff(surv_formula, data = data_clean)
  }, error = function(e) {
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(logrank_test)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test$chisq, length(logrank_test$n) - 1)
  return(p_value)
}

# Compare PFS performance
cat("\n--- PFS (Progression-Free Survival) Comparison ---\n")

# Qualitative
qual_pfs_c <- calculate_c_index(survival_qualitative, "pfs_time", "relapse_event", "qualitative_group")
qual_pfs_p <- calculate_logrank_pvalue(survival_qualitative, "pfs_time", "relapse_event", "qualitative_group")

# Quantitative

# Create comparison table

             ifelse(is.null(quant_os_c$aic), NA_real_, quant_os_c$aic),
             ifelse(is.null(ml_os_c$aic), NA_real_, ml_os_c$aic))
) %>%
  mutate(

  )
```

```{r model_comparison_table}
# ==============================
# Model Comparison Table
```
